summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) via the GSD wave-based orchestration workflow, then debug and fix the resulting SDK integration issues in the web app.
summary.outcome: Completed Wave 1-3 plans via subagents, then spent the majority of the session debugging the checkpoint for Plan 19.1-05 (Rewire Web App Hooks to SDK). Fixed 5 critical integration bugs through Playwright-driven testing. 9/10 operations verified working; bin/delete-to-bin remains broken.

repo: The web app uses a dual-path architecture: SDK handles folder CRUD while old service handles file upload — any mixed IPNS writes cause 409 Conflict due to stale sequence numbers.
setApiClientConfig() must be called on @cipherbox/api-client before any IPNS operations — it was never called during SDK init, silently breaking all publish/resolve flows.
New folders created via SDK are stored in Zustand with ipnsPrivateKey: new Uint8Array(0) — the createFolder return value needed to include the actual private key and UUID.
The SDK's loadBin() must be called AFTER the old initializeBin service finishes, otherwise it can't resolve the bin IPNS record (different initialization timing).
ensureFolderRegistered() created a state corruption loop: it preserved stale seq numbers from the store, overwriting the SDK's post-mutation seq number and causing 409s on subsequent operations.

The old download service chain (file-metadata.service.ts → ipns.service.ts → custom-instance.ts) uses a different IPNS resolution path than the SDK, causing decryption failures for SDK-uploaded files.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish in sdk-core needed a 409 retry that re-resolves the current IPNS sequence number — the old service had withConflictRetry + resyncFolder but sdk-core did not.
The @cipherbox/api-client generated functions (e.g. ipnsControllerPublishRecord) are used by sdk-core/ipns but require setApiClientConfig() to be called first in the consuming app.
TextEditorDialog.tsx used the old download service directly, bypassing the SDK — needed to be rewired to client.downloadFromIpns().

code.finding: SDK init location — setApiClientConfig() and client.loadBin() must both be called here, with loadBin deferred until after the old initializeBin service completes.
ensureFolderRegistered — final simplified form: skip entirely if SDK already has the folder. Earlier attempts to sync children/seq/privateKey from the store all created new edge cases.
createFolder must return both the FolderEntry UUID (for store id) and the IPNS private key. The store was using ipnsName as the folder id, causing navigation lookup failures.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needed a single 409 retry that re-resolves the current sequence number from the API before retrying the publish.
Rewired from two-step (upload.service + useFileOperations.addFiles) to single client.uploadFile() call to eliminate dual-path IPNS write conflicts.
Rewired to client.downloadFromIpns() — old path used different IPNS resolution that couldn't decrypt SDK-uploaded files.
Integration test covering full lifecycle (create folder, upload, download, rename, delete) using test-login secret endpoint. All 8 operations pass at SDK level.

workflow: Playwright MCP (headed, manual drive) is more effective than Playwright scripts for debugging UI integration bugs — avoids selector brittleness and lets you observe real browser state.
When debugging dual-path state bugs, SDK-level integration tests (vitest, real API) cleanly separate SDK correctness from web app wiring issues.
Random email per E2E test run prevents state pollution from previous runs — critical for filesystem-per-user apps.
GSD checkpoint plans (autonomous: false) allow pausing mid-phase for human verification, but extended debugging sessions can be driven by the agent via Playwright without user interaction.
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error in Claude Code is a runtime bug (fires after all tool calls complete) — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine actual success.

friction: Initial plan 19.1-02 was rejected by user after execution — required resetting the branch to main and re-running Wave 1, wasting agent execution.
ensureFolderRegistered became a whack-a-mole: each fix (preserve seq, preserve privateKey, sync children) introduced a new edge case, eventually requiring full removal.
Playwright file upload required mcp__playwright__browser_run_code workaround since the upload zone uses a hidden file input — standard file_upload tool couldn't target it.
Background task notifications arrived after work was already completed, creating noise and confusion about which test run results were being referenced.
SDK integration tests hit 30s timeouts due to IPNS delegated routing retries — not a bug but makes the test suite slow.
The test-login endpoint required a secret that had to be discovered (TEST_LOGIN_SECRET) — not documented near the auth code.
HMR hook count change error from restructuring useDropUpload — React's rules of hooks caused a visible error in the running dev server mid-session.
open_items: Bin/delete-to-bin is broken: SDK's loadBin() can't load bin state initialized by the old service, so deleteToBin silently falls back to hard delete. Needs investigation into SDK bin IPNS resolution path.
useFileUpload and useFileDelete were explicitly left on the old service path (architecturally different from SDK upload) — still tech debt to fully remove old upload service.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes pnpm -r run build to fail (though pnpm --filter web build succeeds).

Atomic commits for all fixes were in progress but only Commits 1-2 were completed before transcript end — remaining fixes (folder UUID, upload rewire, download rewire, 409 retry, bin loadBin) still need individual commits.
sdk-debug.spec.ts test file was created for debugging and should either be promoted to a permanent E2E test or deleted.
packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts is a new integration test suite — should be reviewed for inclusion in CI pipeline.
The old upload service, download service, and ipns service are now partially deprecated but still in the codebase — full removal deferred.
